subject: Pipeline hygiene: consolidated renewal corrections + action scan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline hygiene: consolidated renewal corrections + action scan

Team —

Quick heads-up from Finance after tonight's forecast ingest: the automated commit import flagged a handful of inconsistencies across this week's renewal entries (ARR mismatch, stale stage, and one duplicate opportunity). I ran a reconciliation pass and attached a short CSV with the proposed corrections.

Ask: could account owners verify the updates for their accounts by EOD tomorrow? We need to close the loop so the month-end forecast and the credit-approval board have an accurate refresh. Specifically:
- Confirm the proposed stage change for BrightByte (move from Forecast -> Committed) if legal is on the DocuSign path.
- Verify Helios Labs procurement timeline — they still show "Negotiation" but procurement confirmed a PO was raised.
- Nimbus AI is flagged as at-risk (usage drop); please provide an outreach plan or move to At-Risk in the tracker.

I've also included a short summary of high-impact rows in the CSV (reason column). If you disagree with any change, reply inline or mark the sheet; we'll hold the final commit until the group signs off.

Related: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XyR-forecast-hygiene-sheet (read-only until you confirm edits).

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: renewal_changes_20250805.csv

Folks — following up with the cleaned commit_diff_log.xlsx attached and a short action list based on account-owner feedback so far:

High-priority rows (please action or confirm by 5pm PT today):
- BrightByte — proposed: Committed, DocuSign pending. Owner: Stephanie. Link to HS record: HS-23458.
- Helios Labs — proposed: Committed, procurement email received (procurement@helioslabs.com). Owner: Ben.
- Nimbus AI — moved to At-Risk in the sheet; owner: Stephanie, recommended outreach: usage review + 30-day credit.

If you want Finance to hold the commit for the board, say so explicitly in your reply and we will not push the change to the month-end extract. Otherwise we'll push the vetted corrections into the canonical forecast at midnight Friday.

Attachments: commit_diff_log.xlsx, renewal_changes_20250805.csv
